{{Update|[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]}}
[[File:MiniSubElfa.jpg|thumb|150px|The ''[[Elfa]]'', a type of submersible.]]
{{Quote|I could get you a Hydrosphere Explorer if you're prepared to wait a few weeks. An Ubrikkian repulsorsub. A V-Fin. A Trade Federation submarine, even.|A Rodian merchant|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
'''Submarines''', '''submersibles''' or '''repulsorsubs''' were vehicles designed to operate [[Water/Legends|underwater]] on terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. Many were used for research and exploration, especially in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. They had limited mobility and mostly came in small one-man designs. Several companies designed luxury submersibles that could be used in tours or for private use.

The amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and two of his party members used a submersible to descend to a secret [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] [[Hrakert Station|harvester station]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] in their quest for the underwater [[Star Map]]. [[Darth Bandon]] and his aides might have also used a submersible (or multiple submersibles) to catch up with Revan and [[Mission to Hrakert Station|confront]] him.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] made use of [[Trade Federation submarine|U-boats]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], [[Quelev Tapper]] bought such a craft on [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]] to search for the wreck of the [[Emperor's Shadow (shuttle)|''Emperor's Shadow'']].<ref name="KC">{{JournalCite|7|The Kaal Connection}}</ref>

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] employed submersibles in a variety of ventures, including one involving the mining of [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]] on the planet [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. Several submersibles were in use on Calrissian's [[GemDiver Station]], such as the Submersible Mining Environment ''[[Fast Hand]]''.
